judgments.current_judgment: A is complete: on DEV11, L/D/E improve the published Q1 mean gated MSE by 4.0731%/3.4995%/3.6704% (math), and 4.0701%/3.4973%/3.6617% (BF16). All three improve 11/11 sources; L beats E on 10/11 and D on 11/11. E beats D on 9/11 with mean D-E=2.5464098e-5, about 99.5% from the high expert. The currently best L correction has matrix rank at most 32 and folds into the same Q1 linear operator. The tested nonlinear features do not improve on that linear control; video quality and actual latency remain unmeasured. Compared with old V4, the base, Q basis and feature scaling/centering changed together; no single-change causal attribution.
